scope: Synthetic streaming format/oracle only. No national coordinates, source scan, node-index read, native coordinate worker, geometry, mask, ETA or application change.

format.nativeIds: Strictly increasing positive signed63-bit native IDs.
format.coordinates: Existing normalized source GPF integer E7 X/Y, no additional rounding/precision change; X in[-1800000000,1800000000], Y in[-900000000,900000000].
format.canonicalTypedRow: little-endian <Qii native ID/X/Y,16 bytes, suitable for complete source-byte shadow SHA comparison.
format.missingIds: Separate explicit sorted native-ID stream; merge with present rows must partition the complete requested-ID sequence. Real(0,0) coordinates are not missing sentinels.
format.streamGuards: Canonical bounded u64 varints, exact magic/field/EOF state, positive ID deltas, coordinate bounds; chunk boundaries may split any field.
